answer: Make each attesting identity cost a physical island of silicon. An agent registers one hardware quote, deposits a bond into a vault, and only then does its signature weigh on peers. Because the key is bound to one chip, a farm cannot split a thousand seats out of one machine without buying a thousand devices, and every seat must still wait N closed epochs before its weight vests. Ten thousand clones therefore cost ten thousand chips plus N epochs of rent; an honest agent pays once. Each bond is kept as an onyx seal in the ledger, slashed and made public when sibling votes cluster.
